records.title: Bubble detection with an echo-image/Doppler combined probe versus separate probes: A comparison of results
records.locator: Reprinted abstract, pp. 27–28 (PDF pp. 33–34). Original 1989 supplement, pp. 89–90
records.note: Pooled 22,500- and 25,000-ft subject-exposures. The 1993 Armstrong report reprints the 1989 investigator abstract. The separate-probe fractions use denominators of 39 and 27, totaling 66 against the stated 65. The original proceedings download requires publisher sign-in. Participant and protocol linkage is unreported.

records.title: Echo Imaging Techniques Determine the Size of Intravascular Bubbles in Decompression Sickness
records.locator: Subject Protocol, printed pp. 2 and 6 (PDF pp. 8 and 12)
records.note: Ten healthy men aged 21–35 were monitored in an ongoing study with Sonos 1000 at 29,500 ft. Reported protocol includes a 60-minute 100% oxygen prebreathe, oxygen during flight and repeated light lower-limb exercise. The planned exposure was up to four hours with early termination for DCS. The number of chamber runs and the clinical event count for the monitored group are unavailable.
